conflicts.steps.en: Compare → edit and save → mark and stage → review staged result → continue
conflicts.steps.zh-CN: 查看差异 → 编辑并保存 → 标记暂存 → 检查暂存结果 → 继续操作

conflicts.rebaseSides.en: During Rebase, stage 2 is the rebased target so far; stage 3 is the commit being replayed. Inspect the commit IDs before choosing a side.
conflicts.rebaseSides.zh-CN: Rebase 时，第 2 侧是已重放的目标结果，第 3 侧是正在重放的提交；选择前请核对提交 ID。

conflicts.saveFirst.en: Save the working file before staging. Choosing a complete side updates the working file; staging remains a separate step.
conflicts.saveFirst.zh-CN: 编辑后先保存，再标记暂存。选择完整一侧只更新工作文件，仍需单独标记暂存。

conflicts.overwrite.en: Replace the saved working file {{path}} with {{side}}, or delete it if that side is absent. Current manual resolution edits will be replaced. The Index remains unmerged until you stage.
conflicts.overwrite.zh-CN: 将磁盘文件 {{path}} 替换为{{side}}；此侧不存在时删除文件。当前手动处理结果将被替换，Index 仍需单独标记暂存。

conflicts.manualOnly.en: This path, file type or conversion requires manual resolution. Review both versions and stage the saved result.
conflicts.manualOnly.zh-CN: 此路径、文件类型或转换配置需要手动处理；请检查两侧并暂存保存后的结果。

conflicts.fallback.en: The native merge editor is unavailable for this repository or host. Opened the working file for manual resolution.
conflicts.fallback.zh-CN: 当前仓库或宿主无法打开原生合并编辑器，已打开工作文件供手动处理。

conflicts.reviewNext.en: Git has no unmerged entries. Inspect the staged result before continuing; this does not prove the resolution is correct.
conflicts.reviewNext.zh-CN: Git 已无未合并条目。请检查暂存结果后继续；这不代表内容已经正确解决。

conflicts.changed.en: The conflict or working file changed. Refresh the conflict details before choosing a side.
conflicts.changed.zh-CN: 冲突或工作文件已变化，请刷新冲突详情后重新选择。

conflicts.unavailable.en: Conflict details are unavailable in this host.
conflicts.unavailable.zh-CN: 当前宿主不支持冲突详情。

conflicts.unsaved.en: Save your unsaved repository files before replacing a conflict version.
conflicts.unsaved.zh-CN: 替换冲突版本前，请先保存仓库中未保存的文件。
